scope: Agricultural and applied economics policy translation, food affordability, and agricultural data research

records.name: Council on Food, Agricultural & Resource Economics (C-FARE)
records.description: National organization that translates agricultural and applied economics research into educational programming and policy-relevant information for policymakers, federal leaders, stakeholders, researchers, and practitioners.
records.availability_notes: C-FARE primarily provides research translation, webinars, newsletters, and policy education rather than direct grants, case management, or enrollment services. Program topics and event schedules change. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: C-FARE: Affordability Under Pressure — Challenges Across the Food Supply Chain
records.description: Research and policy webinar examining how inflation, economic shocks, and changing consumer behavior affect producers, food businesses, supply chains, and households.
records.availability_notes: This is an educational research resource rather than individualized financial assistance or a current price database. Recording, speaker materials, and supporting links may change. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: C-FARE: Big Data — Background and Applications in Agriculture and Food Systems
records.description: Educational webinar covering agricultural big data, remote sensing, geospatial and consumer scanner data, data quality and access, cover-crop measurement, and applications for agricultural and food-system decisions.
records.availability_notes: The supplied URL slug suggests alternative fuels, but the current page title and content are Big Data: Background and Applications used in Agriculture and Food Systems. This is a research resource, and some referenced datasets have access restrictions or reporting lags. Verified August 6, 2026.
